boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten verified no-cost ways to gather, explore, exercise, and get around Stan State and Turlock, with eligibility and access conditions noted.

cards.title: Browse the University Art Gallery
cards.subtitle: A free public gallery inside the Theatre Building
cards.notes: Meet by the Theatre Building, browse the current exhibition together, and use Thursday’s extended gallery hours when convenient.
cards.short_summary: Contemporary art provides an easy conversation-focused campus hang.
cards.evidence_claim: The university states that University Art Gallery events are free and open to the public and identifies its Theatre Building location and regular hours.
cards.access_notes: Open to the public during posted gallery hours; the university says the gallery is wheelchair accessible.

cards.title: See Student Art Downtown
cards.subtitle: Two university gallery rooms on North First Street
cards.notes: Gather at the downtown gallery, compare work in the Main and BFA rooms, and confirm the current exhibition before setting out.
cards.short_summary: A downtown gallery outing centered on university and contemporary artwork.
cards.evidence_claim: An official university page states that Stan State Art Space offers free admission for entry and receptions and is open to the public at 226 North First Street.
cards.source_title: Stanislaus State Events and News Archive
cards.access_notes: Public access; check the current gallery schedule because exhibitions and operating days can change.

cards.title: Trade Stories at the History Museum
cards.subtitle: Local artifacts and 25 displays on South Center Street
cards.notes: Visit on Saturday, choose one display each to investigate, then compare what you learned about Turlock’s community history.
cards.short_summary: A volunteer-run museum offers a shared look at Turlock’s past.
cards.evidence_claim: The Turlock Historical Society states that museum admission is free and describes 25 display areas devoted to Turlock history.
cards.access_notes: Open to the public on Saturdays; verify the current closing time with the museum because its official pages show differing Saturday hours.

cards.title: Join a Free Library Program
cards.subtitle: Public activities in the Turlock Library community room
cards.notes: Filter the county calendar to Turlock, pick a book discussion, craft, or movement session, and check any age guidance before attending.
cards.short_summary: The library calendar supplies rotating, structured ways to socialize without buying anything.
cards.evidence_claim: The Stanislaus County Library events calendar states that all listed events are free and open to the public and includes programs at Turlock Library.
cards.source_title: Events and Classes - Stanislaus County Library
cards.access_notes: Open to the public; consult the live calendar for dates, registration requirements, age ranges, and cancellations.

cards.title: Plan a First-Friday Gallery Meetup
cards.subtitle: Monthly free-admission day at the Carnegie Arts Center
cards.notes: Choose the first Friday of the month, meet at the information desk, and explore the current exhibitions without paying gallery admission.
cards.short_summary: A monthly free day turns the downtown arts center into a no-cost group outing.
cards.evidence_claim: The Carnegie Arts Center FAQ states that the first Friday of every month is free for all visitors.
cards.access_notes: Free for everyone on the first Friday of each month; visit during posted gallery hours and check for holiday changes.

cards.title: Form an Intramural Team
cards.subtitle: No-cost campus leagues for currently enrolled students
cards.notes: Invite classmates, select a listed sport, and register through FusionPlay; solo participants can enter as free agents seeking a team.
cards.short_summary: Student leagues create a recurring social activity with no participation charge.
cards.evidence_claim: Stanislaus State says intramural participation is free for currently enrolled students and permits individuals without teams to register as free agents.
cards.access_notes: Limited to eligible Campus Recreation members; currently enrolled, fee-paying students participate free and must bring valid identification.

cards.title: Meet for a Student Swim
cards.subtitle: Free pool access for students with active membership
cards.notes: Check the current pool schedule, bring swim gear, meet at the Aquatic Facility, and complete the required waiver before entering.
cards.short_summary: An eligibility-limited pool session offers a relaxed active hang for students.
cards.evidence_claim: The university states that students with active membership use the Aquatic Facility free and may sign a waiver at the facility without buying a pass.
cards.access_notes: Only students with active membership receive free access; check current weekday sessions, closures, and waiver requirements.

cards.title: Walk Four Laps Together
cards.subtitle: Daylight track access for student recreation members
cards.notes: Check in at the Recreation welcome desk, keep to the outside four lanes, and turn four laps into a one-mile conversation walk.
cards.short_summary: The stadium track supports a simple campus walk with a clear one-mile loop.
cards.evidence_claim: Campus Recreation says the track is open to students and members during facility daylight hours when unreserved, and four laps equal one mile.
cards.access_notes: Eligible students and members must check in; use is limited to daylight facility hours and times when the track is not reserved.

cards.title: Take a Group X Class
cards.subtitle: Drop-in fitness classes included with student access
cards.notes: Pick a beginner-friendly class from the current schedule, arrive with a friend, and note whether it meets in the Recreation Center or Village Café.
cards.short_summary: Instructor-led workouts make a structured, social alternative to exercising alone.
cards.evidence_claim: The university says current-student Campus Recreation access is included in tuition, Group X requires no sign-up, and membership classes carry no additional charge.
cards.access_notes: For eligible Campus Recreation members; current students need a Warrior ID and required release, and should consult the active class schedule.

cards.title: Take a Fare-Free Turlock Ride
cards.subtitle: Free fixed-route travel for college students and faculty
cards.notes: Bring student identification, choose a fixed route and destination, and use the Transit Center to transfer while exploring Turlock together.
cards.short_summary: Fare-free fixed-route service lets students turn a local trip into a no-cost outing.
cards.evidence_claim: Turlock Transit lists fixed-route fares as free for college students and faculty and advises qualifying riders to be ready to present photo identification.
cards.access_notes: Free eligibility applies to fixed-route service for college students and faculty; carry photo ID and avoid paid On-Demand or paratransit services.
